title: Logo
slide_intent: Show how a symbol can express a relationship and how to choose a signature for the space available. The reader needs to recognize the same identity across different shapes of placement.
strategic_value: The solid half and dotted half can keep Halfkey’s distinction between owner and agent legible when the symbol appears alone.
demonstration: A large horizontal lockup pairs a split circle with the lowercase wordmark. Beneath it, three specimen cards isolate the symbol, the wordmark and a stacked lockup.
practical_value: A designer can choose the standalone symbol for an avatar, the wordmark where the symbol is already present, or the stacked lockup for a square or tall format.

content_islands.name: Running header
content_islands.spec: Place the book identifiers at upper left and Logo with page 04 at upper right.

content_islands.name: Primary lockup
content_islands.spec: Place the dark solid semicircle and blue dotted half to the left of the lowercase wordmark. Give the lockup most of the upper row.

content_islands.name: Lockup explanation
content_islands.spec: Use the narrow upper-right column to explain the meaning of the two halves and the wordmark treatment.

content_islands.name: Alternate signatures
content_islands.spec: Place three equal specimen cards across the lower row. Center the symbol, wordmark and stacked lockup in their respective cards. Keep each usage caption at the bottom.
